title: Repair promotion validation for approved runtime debris and rollback snapshots

transaction_provenance.candidate_failure: Forbidden ignored directory found in candidate root: .orchestrator/logs/
transaction_provenance.rollback_failure: Tracked git tree is dirty ( M): .orchestrator/task-briefs/sup_runtime_v10_promotion_git_dir_enotdir_20260808.md

transaction_provenance.preflight_failure: Supervisor process admission lock generation mismatch

diagnosis: Git reports the ignored .orchestrator/logs directory as one directory record, so adding that path to a regular-file allowlist cannot admit or validate its leaves.

The mutable tracked task brief is provenance-bound bootstrap residue; rollback must use the separately materialized immutable checkout at the captured HEAD/tree and must not copy mutable worktree bytes.
A /proc/locks row identifier can change across release and reacquire even when the same verified supervisor FLOCK, owner generation, file and range remain bound.
implemented_guards: Admit only the exact .orchestrator/logs directory and enumerate it through anchored descriptors; each leaf must be a same-filesystem, single-link, non-executable regular .log file with a safe direct filename.
Keep unknown ignored directories, nested log payloads, symlinks, executable logs, arbitrary task-brief ignored directories, tracked-tree drift and importable source fail-closed.
Materialize rollback from the captured commit/tree and prove contaminated mutable task-brief bytes are absent from the rollback checkout.

With explicit opt-in, normalize kernel_lock_id only when both observations have the verified FLOCK/ADVISORY/WRITE/0..EOF shape; compare every path, device, inode, content, time, class, mode, range and owner-generation field exactly.

verification.command: ./.venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -m pytest -q scripts/test_promote_supervisor_runtime.py -k 'runtime_log or generated_logs or admission_lock_id_churn or dynamic_flock or every_other_identity_drift or capture_promotion_snapshot_passes_allow_legacy_admission_lock_id_churn or materialized_rollback_uses_head or ignored_task_brief_source_directory'
